name: Cook & Persinger 2001: frequency-modulated field, right hemisphere (20 min)
summary: A frequency-modulated field (here the 849-point 'Thomas' table at 3-ms points) along the right hemisphere at 1 uT for 20 min in a darkened, quiet room. Cook & Persinger 2001 (16 people) reported a sensed presence (a 'sentient being') in 75% of above-average temporal-lobe-sign scorers with right-sided fields (60% with fields across both hemispheres) and in none of the below-average scorers.
notes: Cook & Persinger applied a 1-uT frequency-modulated field 'through a helmet, either along the right hemisphere or across both hemispheres' for 20 min; this file is the right-sided arm and persinger-cook-2001-fm-bilateral the other. The abstract names only a 'frequency-modulated' field; the Thomas table at 3 ms (the lab's frequency-modulated pattern over the right hemisphere in Tiller & Persinger 2002) is an assumption. The table is Table 1 of US 6,234,953 (Thomas, Prato, Kavaliers & Persinger), 849 points, which the lab replayed at 3 ms per point (Buckner 2015; Murugan 2013). A 3-ms pause after each pass (the 3-ms pixel plus 3-ms interstimulus optimum Persinger & Belanger-Chellew 1999 found in rats) gives Buckner's 2.55-s cycle. Within it 18 pulses slow from about 12 to 5 per second (the lab's '25 to 6 Hz' labels do not follow from the table). Sites T8 and TP8 are an inference; the left channels stay silent. The effect appeared only in the half of the sample preselected by high temporal-lobe-sign scores, the trait Granqvist 2005 and French 2009 found predicted reports regardless of the field; n = 16, one lab. Independent double-blind tests found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history, implanted devices or pregnancy; stop at once on fear, headache or distress.
setting: A darkened, quiet room, eyes covered, reclining; note the time and side of anything felt.
schedule: One 20-min exposure; at most once a week. Compare with a blinded sham (the app's Blind option).
source: Cook & Persinger 2001, Percept Mot Skills 92:447 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11361305/ ; Cook & Persinger 1997, Percept Mot Skills 85:683 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9347559/ ; Tiller & Persinger 2002, Percept Mot Skills 94:26 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11883572/ ; Thomas, Prato, Kavaliers & Persinger, US 6,234,953 B1, Table 1 https://patents.google.com/patent/US6234953B1/en ; Buckner et al. 2015, PLoS ONE 10(4):e0124136 (849 points at 3 ms, 2.55-s cycle) https://europepmc.org/article/MED/25875081 ; Murugan 2013, thesis, Laurentian University, pp. 44-45 (248-point burst-x, 849-point Thomas pulse, 3-ms points) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/39c9c1ad-70ba-458d-a819-d24c20da217a ; Persinger & Belanger-Chellew 1999, Percept Mot Skills 89:486 (3-ms pixel and interstimulus optimum in rats) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10597585/ ; French et al. 2009, Cortex 45:619 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18635163/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
